objective: Step 1 of T-20260929-50: 3 signal rows (BTC, ETH, EW10) in one split-table analysis; no trading rule, no costs. Continue to the batch only if the preregistered continue_rule passes.

parameters.signal_description: Bitcoin, Coinbase USD 15m before 2017-08 else Binance BTCUSDT
Ethereum, Coinbase USD 15m before its Binance listing else Binance ETHUSDT
equal-weight mean of W over the available coins among BTC, ETH, LTC, BCH, LINK, DOGE, AVAX, UNI, AAVE, DOT (>=2 required)

sources: data/research/crypto/raw/binance/<SYMBOL>USDT monthly 15m kline zips (BTC, ETH, LTC, BCH, LINK, DOGE, AVAX, UNI, AAVE, DOT; read via scripts/fetch_crypto_session_prices.load_binance_15m, cached months only)
data/sip/daily SPY/QQQ/IWM open and close read with duckdb memory_limit 400MB; SPY dates are the trading calendar
data_v1_h20260929_50_crypto15m_sipdaily.join: Monday trading date = first ETF trading date on or after the calendar Monday of the week; weeks with no trading date are skipped

feature_v1_h20260929_50_weekend_return.definition: W = price at Sunday 24:00 UTC (close of the 15m bar opening 23:45 UTC) / price at Friday 16:00 America/New_York (open of the 15m bar opening at 16:00 ET) - 1; no bar with open time at or after Monday 00:00 UTC is used; EW10 = mean of the available coins' W (both endpoints present), at least 2 coins required; BTC and ETH need their own endpoints
feature_v1_h20260929_50_weekend_return.holiday_rule: if the calendar Monday is not a trading day the next trading day is the Monday sample, W still ends Sunday 24:00 UTC, and the sample is flagged holiday_monday=true; Friday-holiday weeks are flagged friday_holiday=true and use the last close before the Monday sample for the gap

label_v1_h20260929_50_monday_segments.definition: gap = open[M]/close[prev trading day]-1; oc = close[M]/open[M]-1; o2o = open[next trading day after M]/open[M]-1, in basis points, from SIP daily adjusted bars; M = Monday sample date

validation_v1_h20260929_50_split_table.statistic: mean(group A) - mean(group B) in bp, Welch t (unequal variances), n per group
validation_v1_h20260929_50_split_table.placebo: 500 random permutations of W among the weeks of each (signal, sample), numpy default_rng seed 20260929; report the share of placebo |t| values below the real |t| and the placebo 90th percentile of |t|
validation_v1_h20260929_50_split_table.continue_rule: exists (signal in BTC,ETH,EW10; ETF in QQQ,SPY; segment in oc,o2o) with grouping neg such that in BOTH post_luna and anchor samples: mean(W<0) < mean(W>=0), |t|>=2.0, |t| > placebo p90 of |t|; gap segment, IWM, big grouping and full sample are informational
validation_v1_h20260929_50_split_table.refuted_labels: in_gap_priced_before_fill if the gap segment shows W<0 lower, |t|>=2 in both recent samples for QQQ or SPY for some signal; else no_predictive_power
validation_v1_h20260929_50_split_table.holiday_mondays: included in the main table, additionally reported ex-holiday as informational

benchmark_v1_h20260929_50_shuffle_placeb.primary: 500-shuffle placebo of W across weeks, seed 20260929
benchmark_v1_h20260929_50_shuffle_placeb.gap_replication: the gap-segment difference and t are reported to check whether the published effect exists in our data at all

keep_rule: See contracts.validation.validation_v1_h20260929_50_split_table.continue_rule. Preregistered before any return, t value or placebo is computed. Reading of the brief frozen here: the same (signal, ETF, segment) cell must satisfy the criteria in both recent samples; 12 gating cells, no multiple-testing correction, which makes the gate lenient rather than strict.
